leftEvidence.title: Josiah restores an order linked to Solomon

points.label: Solomon-relative action
points.left: Josiah orders priests and Levites for Passover, places the ark in the house Solomon built, and refers to written divisions associated with David and Solomon.
points.right: The account of Josiah’s Passover places the ark in Solomon’s house and orders Levitical service according to David’s writing and Solomon’s magnificence.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: Temple servants prepare according to Moses’ command within inherited royal arrangements.
points.right: Priests, Levites, leaders, and the people prepare a large Passover offering.

payload.posture: Chronicles and 1 Esdras remember Solomon’s house and ordering traditions inside Josiah’s Passover.
payload.tension: The witnesses overlap while using distinct wording for Solomon’s written order or magnificence.
payload.title: Solomon’s Temple order in two Passover accounts
